messages:
maya: Hi folks, Im onboarding and my first on-call week starts next Monday. A few quick things: I dont see PagerDuty in my apps, who owns the shadow checklist, and where do I sign up for the incident sims? CC: @ravi for PD access.

ravi: Welcome @maya! I wasnt seeing you in the rotation either, added you now. You should get an invite from PagerDuty shortly. Shadow checklist is in the runbooks repo under /oncall/shadow-checklist.md. If you still cant access the vault, file an infra-access ticket and tag it "oncall-shadow" and Ill expedite.

alex: Ill take a buddy slot Tues 09:00-09:45. We do a golden-path mock and then a short live drill so you can practice ack/escalation. Typical flow: ack -> gather context -> mitigations -> handover.

lee: Sign up for sims here: https://go/rw-oncall-sims. Put your GitHub handle in the notes. Also join #incidents-watcher so you can watch channel traffic during shadow week.

maya: Thanks! The checklist is a bit terse  can someone share a compact pre-shadow todo list I can run through tonight?

alex: Short pre-shadow checklist I give new folks:
1) Confirm PD login + enable mobile push and test with a low-priority alert.
2) Confirm read-only access to runbooks and creds vault.
3) Run local reenact in dev (see snippet below).
4) Read one recent postmortem to see expected running doc format.

alex: Local reenact snippet from runbooks:
```bash
# dev reenact: trigger CPU alert in dev cluster
kubectl apply -f tools/load-gen.yaml -n dev-test
sleep 20
kubectl logs -f deploy/load-gen -n dev-test
```

ravi: Note: dont use production creds during reenacts. If you need vault access, request via infra-access and include "shadow" in the reason.

oncall-coordinator: @maya added to the shadow cohort starting 2026-06-01 and assigned alex as buddy. Reserved sim Wed 2026-06-02 14:00-15:00. Please finish the orientation checklist here before you shadow: https://go/rw-oncall-checklist

maya: One more practical question: whats the escalation ladder if I get a real page while shadowing? Bullet TL;DR please.

lee: Escalation TL;DR:
- 0-15m: Own the first response  ack the page in PD, post initial context in #incidents, start the running doc.
- 15-30m: If unresolved, escalate to secondary PD contact and @oncall-lead in the channel.
- 30-60m: If impact is P1 or customer-facing, call the on-call lead and create an incident channel using the template.
- After: assign postmortem owner within 48h and add action items to the tracking board.

alex: Well do a short live drill during your shadow so you can practice the flow. No one expects perfection on first try. :muscle: 

maya: Thank you all  I dont see the PD invite by EOD Ill ping @ravi. Ill fill the sims form and try the reenact tonight.

sre-bot: Rotation updated: maya added to PagerDuty rotation week starting 2026-06-01. Notifications sent to maya, alex, ravi.
